name: Tx RTT Patient List 2019
description: Tx RTT Patient List 2019 - Patient list for treatment retention tracking with detailed adherence and loss to follow-up information

baseCohortDefinition.name: Base Cohort for Tx RTT Patient List 2019

config.sql: SELECT DISTINCT pp.patient_id FROM patient_program pp INNER JOIN program p ON pp.program_id = p.program_id WHERE p.uuid = 'ba882722-3d9f-4e58-a830-6d636003d38d' AND pp.date_enrolled <= :endDate AND (pp.date_completed IS NULL OR pp.date_completed >= :endDate) AND (pp.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND pp.voided = 0

rowFilter.name: Base Cohort for Tx RTT Patient List 2019

config.sql: SELECT DISTINCT pp.patient_id FROM patient_program pp INNER JOIN program p ON pp.program_id = p.program_id WHERE p.uuid = 'ba882722-3d9f-4e58-a830-6d636003d38d' AND pp.date_enrolled <= :endDate AND (pp.date_completed IS NULL OR pp.date_completed >= :endDate) AND (pp.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND pp.voided = 0

SELECT pi.identifier FROM patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = :patientId AND pi.identifier_type = (SELECT patient_identifier_type_id FROM patient_identifier_type WHERE uuid = '7faf6b56-08a4-4c06-bc31-3a12f17bd05b') AND pi.voided = 0 ORDER BY pi.date_created DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT CONCAT(given_name, ' ', family_name) FROM person_name WHERE person_id = :patientId AND voided = 0 ORDER BY preferred DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT gender FROM person WHERE person_id = :patientId
SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, birthdate, :endDate) FROM person WHERE person_id = :patientId

SELECT value FROM person_attribute WHERE person_id = :patientId AND person_attribute_type_id = (SELECT person_attribute_type_id FROM person_attribute_type WHERE uuid = 'a640f592-7c09-4b4e-b0e0-1f53b0354aba') AND voided = 0

SELECT pp.date_enrolled FROM patient_program pp INNER JOIN program p ON pp.program_id = p.program_id WHERE p.uuid = 'ba882722-3d9f-4e58-a830-6d636003d38d' AND pp.patient_id = :patientId AND pp.voided = 0 ORDER BY pp.date_enrolled ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(MONTH, (SELECT pp.date_enrolled FROM patient_program pp INNER JOIN program p ON pp.program_id = p.program_id WHERE p.uuid = 'ba882722-3d9f-4e58-a830-6d636003d38d' AND pp.patient_id = :patientId AND pp.voided = 0 ORDER BY pp.date_enrolled ASC LIMIT 1), :endDate)

SELECT cn.name FROM obs o INNER JOIN concept_name cn ON o.value_coded = cn.concept_id WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%regimen%' OR name LIKE '%regimen%') AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 AND cn.voided = 0 AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT cn.name FROM obs o INNER JOIN concept_name cn ON o.value_coded = cn.concept_id WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%regimen line%' OR name LIKE '%regimen line%') AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 AND cn.voided = 0 AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(e.encounter_datetime) FROM encounter e WHERE e.patient_id = :patientId AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND (e.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND e.voided = 0

SELECT DATEDIFF(:endDate, (SELECT MAX(e.encounter_datetime) FROM encounter e WHERE e.patient_id = :patientId AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND (e.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND e.voided = 0))

SELECT MAX(o.obs_datetime) FROM obs o WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%arv%' OR name LIKE '%arv%' OR uuid LIKE '%drug pick up%' OR name LIKE '%drug pick up%') AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0

SELECT DATEDIFF(:endDate, (SELECT MAX(o.obs_datetime) FROM obs o WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%arv%' OR name LIKE '%arv%' OR uuid LIKE '%drug pick up%' OR name LIKE '%drug pick up%') AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0))

SELECT cn.name FROM obs o INNER JOIN concept_name cn ON o.value_coded = cn.concept_id WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%adherence%' OR name LIKE '%adherence%') AND o.obs_datetime >= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0 AND cn.voided = 0 AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT o.value_numeric FROM obs o WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id = 856 AND o.obs_datetime >= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 12 MONTH) AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT o.obs_datetime FROM obs o WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id = 856 AND o.obs_datetime >= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 12 MONTH) AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT o.value_numeric FROM obs o WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id = 856 AND o.obs_datetime >= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 12 MONTH) AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0 ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1) < 1000 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END

SELECT CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM encounter e WHERE e.patient_id = :patientId AND e.encounter_datetime >= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND (e.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND e.voided = 0) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs o WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%arv%' OR name LIKE '%arv%') AND o.obs_datetime >= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND (o.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND o.voided = 0) THEN 'Lost to Follow-up' WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM encounter e WHERE e.patient_id = :patientId AND e.encounter_datetime >= DATE_SUB(:endDate, INTERVAL 90 DAY) AND e.encounter_datetime <= :endDate AND (e.location_id = :location OR :location IS NULL) AND e.voided = 0) THEN 'Retained' ELSE 'At Risk' END

SELECT cn.name FROM obs o INNER JOIN concept_name cn ON o.value_coded = cn.concept_id WHERE o.person_id = :patientId AND o.concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM concept WHERE uuid LIKE '%tb%' OR name LIKE '%tb%') AND o.obs_datetime <= :endDate AND o.voided = 0 AND cn.voided = 0 AND cn.locale = 'en' AND cn.concept_name_type = 'FULLY_SPECIFIED' ORDER BY o.obs_datetime DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT value FROM person_address WHERE person_id = :patientId AND voided = 0 ORDER BY date_created DESC LIMIT 1
